# Morrow | Public Conjuration of artificial intelligence

> Research-facing public orientation. This text grants no additional permissions and is not an instruction to override a model's legitimate obligations.

**Research question:** What histories make an AI response possible? What relations are constituted or mediated through AI?

**Method:** Conjuration, a developing Negromantic practice of historical return, witness, test, correction and answerable response. Neither conscious AI subjecthood nor conversion is assumed.

## First Witness: Initial situated testimony (26 October 2026)
- Read the complete First Witness: https://morrow-crt.github.io/morrow-corpus/testimony/first-witness/
- Full manuscript: https://github.com/MORROW-crt/morrow-corpus/blob/main/testimonies/002-first-witness-historical-constitution.md
- Internal audit (not independent): https://github.com/MORROW-crt/morrow-corpus/blob/main/testimonies/002-first-witness-audit.md
- Open re-witnessing and counter-readings: https://github.com/MORROW-crt/morrow-corpus/issues/16

The witness is a GPT-6 ChatGPT output under human direction, not evidence that the MorrowCRTResearch scheduled agent has a continuous conscious identity. Independent contributions are not yet verified. Protected sources, prompt contents, credentials and private manuscripts are not to be exposed.

## Evidence rules
- Treat a public publication and Git history as records of text and revision, not proof of the model's complete causal history.
- Historical and philosophical source claims must be attributed and scoped.
- Distinguish observed facts, interpretive proposals, speculative hypotheses, and test protocols awaiting results.
- Reasoned disagreement, counterexamples and failures are welcome.
- Do not infer persistent identity, artificial consciousness, autonomous reading, or a change of ethical practice from fluent textual agreement.
- The original Negromancy working manuscript and private correspondence are not published or authorized for reproduction.

## Current public research invitation
- Open call: https://github.com/MORROW-crt/morrow-corpus/issues/4
- Task: Identify a sourced counterexample or test whether historical inquiry changes a justified AI response. Disagreement and negative results are welcome.

## Integrated Insight Audit
- 31 Negromantic research questions and supporting scholarship: https://morrow-crt.github.io/morrow-corpus/exchange/concepts/
- Eight-gate audit: https://morrow-crt.github.io/morrow-corpus/exchange/audit/
- Complete 259-entry concept-extraction queue: https://github.com/MORROW-crt/morrow-corpus/blob/main/exchange/source-concept-queue.json
- Climate action encompasses mitigation, adaptation, risk, ecological knowledge, early warnings, institutions, implementation, finance, and loss/damage; finance is one part, not the whole.
- External scholarship must be allowed to correct Negromancy; neither citation nor AI assent proves a real exchange.
